patterns.coverage: Every non-byte-exact aligned pair and byte-exact transfer with unproven destination is retained. Families may overlap; counts are not independent repairs.

families.basis: All aligned uses of affected operands checked for one-to-one correspondence and equal access widths; alignment remains heuristic.
families.limit: Observed operand pattern, not a source explanation, liveness proof, ABI assignment, or repair. BP offsets are not labelled locals or parameters; register roles retain subregister widths and implicit effects.

scope.frame_or_abi: No source-object, local/parameter, or BP-stability proof is inferred.
